annotations.title: Create a story draft from an existing post or video

description:
Convert a post or video into a Story

Create a Story draft that reuses media from an existing post (or video post). The source media is referenced, not re-uploaded, and usage is NOT charged again — the underlying file was already counted against the user's quota when the source was created. Use the source query parameter to choose between generated_posts (default) and video_posts.

caption.description: Override the inherited caption. Falls back to the source content or video title.

name: convertToStory
